dataset_provenance: Official ann-benchmarks HDF5, SHA-256 in each Volume manifest; pre-split train/test and top-100 exact ground truth; 10,000 test queries for each configured dataset
preprocessing: Upstream dataset_transform dense float arrays unchanged; HMS adapter makes C-contiguous float32; angular handling is internal to each algorithm's upstream adapter
operation_sequence: Instantiate algorithm, load HDF5 train/test, fit once per build definition, then sweep all configured query arguments over the same index; five passes of all 10,000 test queries per query argument; write results HDF5 and recall metrics outside the query timer
query_timer: Upstream runner times the algorithm query call or run_prepared_query call; distance validation and result serialization are outside the timer; best mean per-query time across five passes is reported as QPS
official_published_setup: AWS r6i.16xlarge, 31 parallel Docker containers, hyperthreading disabled, one pinned CPU per algorithm build and query; Docker per-run memory limit=(available-500 MB)/parallelism; default timeout 7200 s per build definition
this_run: Modal app ap-7L5mqGLMUK9NEoBmyRpBHk; three separate 8-CPU/32-GiB containers; each upstream --local algorithm runner pinned to CPU 0, math threads=1, 7200 s timeout per build definition; each dataset comparator runs in the same container as HMS
deviations: Modal CPU model/hardware differs from AWS r6i.16xlarge and varies by dataset
32-GiB configured cgroup memory limit differs from published AWS per-container memory allocation
one algorithm definition at a time inside each dataset container rather than 31 parallel Docker workers
only one historically strongest competitor family per dataset rerun; values within that family's upstream config are not tuned on heldout queries
comparison_scope: Within-dataset, same-container HMS/comparator comparisons only; no comparison to published AWS QPS, no hardware scaling or official leaderboard standing
memory_limit_caveat: Observed cgroup limit does not prove strict enforcement; measured peak usage is unavailable. Official index_size is post-fit process RSS delta.
heldout_policy: HMS build/query grid and competitor families were fixed before the live test queries were accessed; no optimization or parameter revision on heldout query results

comparator_launcher_correction.purpose: Remove accidental --max-n-algorithms 1 before official main() runs, allowing all upstream build definitions; patched before competitor arms started
